task.description: The slides task to execute: modify an existing deck per the instruction.

instruction.description: User instruction for this slides task; always the highest priority.

roomId.description: Target room id injected by the gateway; binds the slides tools to the room. Required.

roomTitle.description: Optional room title for context framing.

fileId.description: Target deck for edit: a file entry id or "active" (the deck currently open on the user's desktop). Defaults to "active".
